component.name: com.hyland.openarch.ecm.core.schema.TypeService
component.documentation: Manage schemas, value types, mixins and primary types using the content-model JSON format.

extension-point.name: model
extension-point.documentation: Contribute content-model JSON resources in the REST model format. A fragment may contain any of schemas, types, mixinTypes and primaryTypes. Definitions are merged by name; duplicates are errors, except identical shared value types. All fragments are collected before model resources with patch="true" are applied as RFC 6902 JSON patches in contribution order. Use component requirements to order patches that depend on each other. For example: <model src="model/custom.json" /> or <model src="model/custom.patch.json" patch="true" />.
